text:
How beautiful to see the day
rise crowned with fire,
and at its kiss of light
the waves shine and the air catch fire!

How beautiful, after the rain
of sad autumn on a blue afternoon,
to breathe in the scent of wet flowers
until one has had enough!

How beautiful, when white snow
falls silently in flakes,
to watch the restless flames
shake their reddish tongues!

How beautiful, when sleepy,
to sleep well... and snore like a church cantor...
And eat... and grow fat... and what a shame
that this alone is not enough!

translation.title: Rhyme LXVII: How Beautiful to See the Day
